course.title: Human Resource Management
course.description: A structured Human Resource Management course built from 10 recorded lectures covering SHRM, workforce planning, job analysis, recruitment, selection, performance, compensation, engagement, and change management.

modules.title: Module 1: Strategic HRM and Workforce Planning
modules.description: Understand strategic human resource management, HR strategy alignment, digital HR transformation, HR metrics, and manpower demand forecasting.

lessons.title: Lecture 1: Strategic Human Resource Management, Objectives, and HR Metrics
lessons.description: Learn why SHRM matters, how HR supports business goals, and how turnover, training ROI, engagement, and cost-per-hire indicate strategic HR impact.

lessons.title: Lecture 2: HR Strategy, Digital HR Transformation, and Implementation
lessons.description: Connect organisational strategy to HR strategy through environmental scanning, workforce capability review, HR implications, implementation, monitoring, and digital HR challenges.

lessons.title: Lecture 3: Manpower Demand Forecasting and Workforce Planning Factors
lessons.description: Study how organisational growth, technology, economic conditions, regulation, seasonal workforce patterns, strategy, competition, and digital transformation shape manpower demand.

modules.title: Module 2: Job Analysis, Job Design, Recruitment, and Selection
modules.description: Build the core HR operations toolkit: job analysis, job descriptions, job specifications, job design, job evaluation, recruitment, selection, and personality assessment.

lessons.title: Lecture 4: Job Analysis, Job Description, and Job Specification
lessons.description: Use a digital marketing agency example to understand job analysis and compare task-based, competency-based, skills-based, and performance-based job descriptions.

lessons.title: Lecture 5: Job Design and Job Evaluation
lessons.description: Learn the job design process, task components, organisational goals, job purpose, and job evaluation factors such as skill, effort, responsibility, and working conditions.

lessons.title: Lecture 6: Recruitment, Selection, and Personality Assessment
lessons.description: Study recruitment and selection methods, internal and external hiring sources, and how traits such as conscientiousness, openness, agreeableness, and emotional stability support role fit.

modules.title: Module 3: Performance, Compensation, Engagement, and Change Management
modules.description: Learn how HR supports performance, employee engagement, rewards, compensation equity, change readiness, stakeholder alignment, and culture during organisational change.

lessons.title: Lecture 7: Performance Management and Performance Appraisal
lessons.description: Review the evolution of performance management and the objectives of appraisal, including measurement, development, goal alignment, communication, and HR validation.

lessons.title: Lecture 8: Employee Engagement and Line Manager Skills in Dynamic Workplaces
lessons.description: Explore line manager responsibilities in modern workplaces, including digital fluency, work-life integration, continuous growth, and organisational agility.

lessons.title: Lecture 9: Compensation Management, Internal Equity, and Total Rewards
lessons.description: Understand compensation from a strategic perspective, including internal equity, market competitiveness, non-financial recognition, rewards, and work-life integration.

lessons.title: Lecture 10: Change Management and Stakeholder Alignment
lessons.description: Learn why change matters and how awareness, planning, stakeholder alignment, implementation, culture, psychological safety, and leadership support successful change.
